A '''mining tool kit'''<ref name="GoA">''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]''</ref> or '''mining kit'''<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref> was comprised of various tools to assist individuals in [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations.<ref name="GoA" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[TasCorp]] manufactured a mining kit, the [[Essential Miner's Gear]], for [[Miner/Legends|miners]] working on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]].<ref name="J15" />
